description:
Cast Time Stretch by paying its mana cost, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Move to your next turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Extravagant Replication triggers, creating a token copy of Shipwreck Dowser.
When the Shipwreck Dowser token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Time Stretch from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat during your second turn.
